interpretation: Publish this exact mapping before the final acceptance execution; record its named-byte identity in every applicable role.
test_ids name actual unittest methods with discovery module identifiers; entries establish intended coverage, never execution status or a passed role.
supporting_test_ids are explicitly insufficient to satisfy the listed actual-byte or protocol probe; an absent release probe stays pending.
Every source case, required protocol step, probe record and mandatory role must be present in actual evidence. Missing work is pending; an executed contradiction is failed.

Each actual-byte mutation begins with an independently valid identified artifact, keeps unrelated expected source/object/geometry/history closure, recomputes transport hashes as needed, and records the intended semantic rejection stage and allocation counters.
All original frozen inputs, thresholds and diagnostic meanings remain unchanged. This new mapping does not amend the adopted requirement matrix.
Names are literal and can be checked against the actual test inventory. Glob patterns, wrapper pass labels and counts alone cannot establish coverage.
Any method replacement, probe change, role omission or applicable numerical implementation change requires an explicit reviewed mapping/decision successor before final execution.
